questions.stem: De acordo com a Organização Marítima Internacional, na resolução Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability (MSC.137(76)), o termo Advance pode ser definido como: Assinale a alternativa CORRETA.

options.A: The distance travelled in the direction of the original course by the midship point of a ship from the rudder order until a heading change of 180°.
options.B: The distance travelled perpendicular to the original heading by the midship point of a ship until a heading change of 90°.
options.C: The distance travelled in the direction of the original course by the midship point of a ship from the rudder order until a heading change of 90°.
options.D: The distance travelled in the direction of the original course by the bow of a ship from the rudder order until a heading change of 90°.
options.E: The distance travelled along the track by the midship point of a ship until a heading change of 90°.

questions.note: Gabarito em inglês é adaptação condensada da definição normativa; para literalidade integral restaurar redação original do item 4.2.3 antes da aprovação.

questions.stem: De acordo com a Organização Marítima Internacional, em Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability (MSC.137(76)), a definição de Tactical diameter corresponde a: Assinale a alternativa CORRETA.

options.A: The distance travelled by the midship point until a heading change of 180°, measured perpendicular to the original heading.
options.B: The distance travelled by the midship point until a heading change of 90°, measured perpendicular to the original heading.
options.C: The distance travelled by the bow until a heading change of 180°, measured perpendicular to the original heading.
options.D: The distance travelled by the midship point until a heading change of 180°, measured parallel to the original heading.
options.E: The distance travelled by the midship point until a heading change of 360°, measured perpendicular to the original heading.

questions.note: Adaptação condensada da definição normativa; requer restauração textual integral para obedecer à exigência de literalidade.

questions.stem: De acordo com a Organização Marítima Internacional, em Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability (MSC.137(76)), o termo First overshoot angle pode ser compreendido como: Assinale a alternativa CORRETA.

options.A: The additional heading deviation during the turning-circle test following the second execute.
options.B: The additional heading deviation during the zig-zag test preceding the second execute.
options.C: The additional heading deviation during the zig-zag test following the third execute.
options.D: The additional heading deviation during the zig-zag test following the second execute.
options.E: The additional rudder angle during the zig-zag test following the second execute.

questions.note: D é a redação integral do item 4.2.7: The first overshoot angle is the additional heading deviation experienced in the zig-zag test following the second execute. A alternativa reproduz o predicado, sem a oração do sujeito.

questions.stem: De acordo com a Organização Marítima Internacional, em Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability (MSC.137(76)), o termo Track reach pode ser definido como: Assinale a alternativa CORRETA.

options.A: The distance along the path described by the midship point measured from the full-astern order until a heading change of 180°.
options.B: The distance along the path described by the midship point measured from the full-astern order until the ship stops in the water.
options.C: The distance along the original course described by the midship point measured until the ship stops in the water.
options.D: The distance along the path described by the bow measured from the full-astern order until the ship stops in the water.
options.E: The distance along the path described by the midship point measured from the rudder order until the ship stops in the water.

questions.note: Adaptação condensada do item 4.2.11; literalidade integral pendente.
